name: Leadpages
summary: Landing pages, pop-ups and alert bars, with unlimited traffic on every Leadpages plan where metered rivals count visitors. The value pick rather than the optimisation pick.
best_for: small businesses building landing pages and simple funnels who want unmetered traffic — no per-visitor anxiety, unlike metered rivals
skip_if: you need deep A/B experimentation or enterprise features — multivariate testing and Smart Traffic start at Optimize ($199/mo) and auto-optimisation at Scale ($399/mo)
honest_knock: It's the value pick, not the optimisation pick — if you're spending big on ads, Unbounce's Smart Traffic and Instapage's 1:1 personalisation go deeper.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per month ($23 billed annually), 25 pages, 1 site
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-10-15 against Leadpages' own machine-readable pricing file at leadpages.com/pricing.md, dated 2026-10-10, and the pricing page in a live browser; USD) The Starter plan is gone, so the cheapest plan is now Pro. Five paid plans plus Enterprise, no free plan, and a 7-day free trial that requires a credit card and converts unless you cancel. Publishing plans: Pro $29/mo or $23 billed annually ($276 a year), 25 pages, 1 site, 1 blog, 5 active integrations and API access; Business $49/mo or $39 annually ($468), 50 pages, 2 sites and lead export. Neither includes A/B testing. Testing and optimisation plans: Grow $99/mo or $79 annually ($948), unlimited pages, 4 sites, manual two-way A/B testing, dynamic text replacement, lead enrichment and anonymous traffic detection; Optimize $199/mo or $159 annually ($1,908), 6 sites, 3 seats, up to four variants, Smart Traffic, heatmaps and auto-personalisation; Scale $399/mo or $319 annually ($3,828), 10 sites, 10 seats, auto-optimisation, cross-page learning, role-based access and audit logs. Enterprise is priced by sales. Annual billing is 20% off. No plan has a traffic cap. Add-ons: $20 a month per extra seat or extra custom domain, $40 per extra client workspace on Scale, and AI credit top-ups from $2.50 for 2,000 credits down to $0.60 per thousand at the 150,000-credit pack. For buyers outside the US: read from a European connection on 15 October 2026, the pricing page shows euros, with Pro at €29 and Business at €49 but Grow at €115 and Optimize at €229 a month, against $99 and $199. That page shows Pro, Business, Grow and Optimize as plan cards and names Scale only in its FAQ.
